Subject: variant_id=WAS-p.Thr45Met gene=WAS accession=P42768 position=45 reference=T alternate=M

Task: Question: does this mutation change the folded shape of the protein? Compare the predicted shape of the normal and mutated protein before deciding. Read the record (hypotheses H1 to H3, evidence E1 to E19, gaps G1 to G6). Write at least 2 test candidates (expected learning, feasibility, cost), then one plan with the single chosen test, a reason for each rejected one, within the remaining budget (200 tool calls, 300 compute seconds). Then handoff.
